messages:
Maya: Quick brief request — we need a one-pager (gated webinar asset) focused on secure deploys: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Make it scannable, include one benchmark stat, one sentence on SLAs, and 4 field-ready bullets. Need draft by EOD Thu.

Jorge: On it. I'll produce a compact comparison table and a one-line SLA summary.

Priya: Ill craft the 4 bullets: exec, platform, security, procurement. Keep them <20 words each.

Sam: Benchmark nugget (from last bench):
```
model: medium-2k, p99 latency over 6k requests
Hosted p99 = 125ms (~$8/1M tokens)
Dedicated p99 = 88ms (~$5.8/1M tokens)
Private p99 = 97ms (~$6.7/1M tokens)
```

Aditi: Add a single-line compliance checklist: encryption at rest, KMS/HSM integration, SOC2 mention, per-route audit logs.

DesignBot: Visual constraints: 1 A4 column, three-column table, tiny latency bars. Provide mock numbers if you want a quick comp.

Maya: Include a one-liner on fallback routing for reliability and a footnote with test config (seq=2048, batch=24, synthetic mix).

Jorge: Draft skeleton: 1-line value prop; 3-col table (latency/cost/control/SLA); security checklist; benchmark callout; 4 bullets; CTA to webinar replay + demo booking.

Priya: Proposed bullets:
- Exec: "Pick the deployment that matches your compliance and uptime needs  turnkey to locked-down."
- Platform: "Same API, same SDKs, consistent SLAs across modes."
- Security: "Private or Dedicated with KMS/HSM, VPC peering, and audit retention controls."
- Procurement: "Hosted pay-as-you-go, Dedicated reserved, Private license + support."

Maya: Perfect  include placeholder testimonial: "Reduced inference cost vs homegrown". Ops: drop SOC2 link when final.

ops-bot: Reminder: compliance link placeholder  https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2

Jorge: I'll post the draft to the marketing board by tomorrow morning for copy/design pass.

Sam: Uploading the bench sheet to GDrive now. Footnote: `model-mid, seq=2048, batch=24, 6k samples`

Maya: Thanks all  will use this as the webinar follow-up gated asset unless design flags. :rocket:
